verdict.rationale: Gram offers a third-party catalog. Developers can discover and import official third-party MCP servers through the official MCP Registry, and the catalog sits alongside custom remote and tunneled servers. Any third-party MCP server can also be registered as a governed remote source. However, the evidence never quantifies the catalog's depth, and much of the breadth depends on the external registry or on teams bringing their own servers. Missing for 10: documented catalog size in the hundreds-to-thousands range, a first-party list of pre-built app/API integrations, and independent corroboration of catalog breadth.
